raw_html: [[Heroic Inspiration]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Heroic Inspiration]]:''' This item inspires you to acts of great heroism, granting a +5% bonus to [[experience point]]s granted by completing quests while it is equipped. This stacks with experience boosting effects from [[Item:Experience Elixir|elixirs]] but does not stack with experience boosting effects from other equippable items.
